entries.introEn: The open shape of this bangle sets a blue pear-shaped stone opposite a small pastel dragonfly. That asymmetry creates a light, animated composition around the wrist, with clear pavé following the curve between them. Pink and purple wings bring colour close to the skin while the cool metal gives the stones a crisp outline. The space between the two ends is part of the design’s visual effect: it lets a shirt cuff or a bare wrist become a quiet background for the garden motif and its opposing drop of blue.
featuresEn: Pastel dragonfly faces a blue pear-shaped Swarovski Zirconia.
Clear pavé follows the rhodium-plated open band.
Hinged Wonder Click closure; exact pictured size article 5737400.
entries.stylingEn: Wear it above a plain cotton cuff or with an uncomplicated short sleeve. Keep the surrounding wrist stack minimal to preserve the gap between the dragonfly and blue stone.

entries.introEn: These dragonflies hang beneath small pavé hoops, letting the wings move just below the ear. Pink and purple stones alternate across the pair, creating a gentle difference between the two sides of the face. A Crystal Pearl at each head brings a round, smooth note to the faceted surfaces. The scale makes the figurative motif easy to recognize while keeping the composition compact. Against a plain blouse or soft knit, the earrings supply colour, movement and a slightly whimsical focal point without requiring a matching necklace.
featuresEn: Pastel dragonflies hang from pavé hoops.
Alternating pink and purple wings with a Crystal Pearl at each head.
Rhodium-plated metal; each earring measures approximately 1 × 3/4 inch.
entries.stylingEn: Pull the hair into a low knot and pair the earrings with a pale blouse or charcoal knit. A bare neckline gives the moving wings space, while a small ring can finish the look.
